title: Gemeente Amsterdam — Parkeervakken (WMS)
note: One of the MapServer maps behind the city's map viewer (data.amsterdam.nl/data/geozoek), read from the viewer's own layer configuration. MapServer publishes one mapfile per theme and no list of them, so each is its own source. Excluded, as of 2026-11-16: parkeervakken_tijdvakken_vrachtwagens hold no features; parkeervakken_label, embed_parkeervakken_label draw nothing at any scale tried; embed_parkeervakken draws nothing at any scale tried.
